sources.title: Stable Audio 3.0 | Generative Audio Models — Stability AI
sources.snippet: Learn about Stable Audio 3.0, a model family trained on fully licensed data, designed to be the foundation for what the audio community builds next. Three of the models are open weights, free to download and build on.

sources.title: GitHub - Stability-AI/stable-audio-3
sources.snippet: Stable Audio 3 is the next generation of Stable Audio: a focused, streamlined platform for inference and fine-tuning, built on lessons from stable-audio-tools. If you're doing foundational research or working with previous Stable Audio models, that repo is still the place to go.
